# Alex Zerntev

> Personal site and blog of Alex Zerntev, Senior AI Engineer at RAW Labs. His work spans AI agents, full-stack applications, and developer tools, including backend systems and user interfaces. Coding agents are part of his development workflow.

Alex joined RAW Labs in 2021, working on data platforms and their web interfaces, the Snapi query language, and developer tooling. He also builds AI agents for enterprise customers, with a focus on reliability and security in production. His career began with service in the Hellenic Air Force, followed by building military-grade software for document management, healthcare, and HR. He holds a BSc in Computer Science and an MSc in Data Science and Information Technologies, specializing in Big Data and AI, from the University of Athens.

## Pages

- [Home](https://alexzerntev.github.io/): who Alex is, a favorite Bruce Lee quote, and how to get in touch
- [Blog](https://alexzerntev.github.io/blog/): notes on coding agents, production agents, and the judgment calls behind them
- [Old Software, New Hands](https://alexzerntev.github.io/blog/old-software-new-hands/): why existing software remains valuable as AI agents take on more of the work of operating it
- [Reality Doesn’t Fit in a Prompt](https://alexzerntev.github.io/blog/reality-doesnt-fit-in-a-prompt/): why information alone does not determine what matters, and where human judgment enters
- [Rebuilding this site with coding agents](https://alexzerntev.github.io/blog/rebuilding-this-site-with-coding-agents/): what stayed human while rebuilding this website with coding agents

## Perspective

- The homepage features Alex's favorite Bruce Lee quote about moving beyond plateaus.
